d: A stunning custom chopper takes more than a great idea. It takes long hours, skilled motorcycle builders and plenty of hard work! Step inside the OCC workshop as the crew tackles demanding designs, detailed fabrication and challenging bike builds. From the first stages of construction to the final reveal, discover the effort behind every custom motorcycle. Watch American Chopper Season 5 Episodes 12, 11, 10, 13, 14, 15 and 16 only on discovery+ India.
